welcome.title: Halve the food your family throws away.
welcome.lead: Frigo is a free fridge coach: it remembers what you bought, warns you before food goes bad and shows how much you saved.
welcome.step1: Add what's in your fridge — 3 taps, or let Frigo guess the date.
welcome.step2: Check the colours: red is expired, yellow means use it soon.
welcome.step3: Tap “Used it” or “Tossed” and watch your savings grow.
welcome.free: Free forever. Supports UN Goal 12.3 — halve food waste by 2030.

tips.dairy: Try a smaller bottle or pack — 0.5 L instead of 1 L.
tips.cheese: Wrap opened cheese well, or freeze brânză for cooking.
tips.eggs: Buy 6 instead of 10, or use spare eggs in an omelette or clătite.
tips.meat: Freeze meat on the day you buy it if you won’t cook it in 2 days.
tips.fish: Cook fish the day you buy it, or freeze it right away.
tips.vegetables: Buy vegetables for 3–4 days at a time; soft ones are perfect for ciorbă.
tips.fruit: Soft fruit makes great compot or baked apples.
tips.bread: Try buying half a loaf, or freeze slices and toast them.
tips.leftovers: Cook smaller portions, or freeze leftovers for another day.
tips.sauces: Opened jars last longer if you write the opening date on the lid.
tips.drinks: Buy smaller bottles; once opened, juice lasts only a few days.
tips.other: Buy smaller amounts and check the Fridge page before shopping.
